column4: Only Chromium smoke test cached (remote-agent.test.ts), home listing dropped; codex mcp list subprocess, two node execs, separate quiesce/exclude/chmod, serial account-health+MCP readiness remain.
15 s interruptible grace before park; openPr/confirm/retry/approveCheckout journal task.transition-requested superseding park. Tests: parking-grace.test.ts, stage-transitions.test.ts.
Tokens, credential writes and clones run with fan-out 3; single E2B inventory list. Tests: provision-git.test.ts, e2b-world.test.ts.
Listing scoped to wiki checkout (prunes .git/node_modules, only SKILL.md/MEMORY.md); no skip-when-clean. Tests: activity-prompt-preparation.test.ts, wiki.test.ts.

SDK partial messages, Codex agentMessage/delta, streamed Messages/Responses rails, ACP accumulation, 150 ms coalescing. Tests: agent-streaming.test.ts, codex-app-server.test.ts, web/live-stream.browser.test.cjs.
Pool/provider/credential reads merged in one activity behind patched(); Starting agent published once; 9→5 pre-turn activities. Tests: turn-preparation.test.ts, turn-preparation-replay.test.ts.
subagent/shell waits excluded from parking (hasLiveWorldWork) in workflow (patched) and activity. Tests: view-parking-workflow.test.ts, agent-start-parking.test.ts, waiting-world-replay.test.ts.
Every agentSlot wait (incl. host memory/capacity) now non-parkable in workflow and activity. Tests: agent-start-parking.test.ts, view-parking-workflow.test.ts, waiting-world-replay.test.ts.
Idle park skips publishing never-published branches at base; clean checkpoints reused; restores check out recorded commits. Tests: checkpoint.test.ts, git-broker.test.ts.
Publish/push now parallel (max 3), single-branch scratch clones (git-broker.test.ts). Merge loop deliberately stays serial; clone per operation remains, mirror cache deferred.
Dirty files now read in bounded sandbox batches (checkpoint.test.ts). Write-access resources still fully re-read/re-uploaded every park; no size/mtime diff or chunk reuse.
Main waiting/queued poll moved to CAN child watcher, evidence read once (landing-wait.test.ts). Ejected duplicate-failure wait (software-dev.ts:3762) and pre-1.21 runs still poll in parent.
Query gated on journaled messages/views with 30 s backstop; one heartbeat (followup-injection.test.ts). Hosted workflow cache not resized: maxCachedWorkflows still 20 (src/temporal/worker.ts:57).
just-do publishes via conversationPublisher behind patched(just-do-conversation-reference-v1). Test: workflow-review-regressions.test.ts.
Child announces appended events so relay wakes immediately; per-socket task visibility cached ≤60 s/token expiry. Tests: worker-process.test.ts, gateway-event-authorization.test.ts.
Merge preflight runs alongside workflow.start; ensured wiki refreshed in background. Test: task-start-critical-path.test.ts; benchmark benchmarks/first-text.ts.
REGRESSION? Sibling-attempt view.updated (web/app.js:3410) no longer refetches /attempts (filter app.js:6975); other attempts' cards stay stale. Test: task-refresh-coalescing.test.cjs.
Export limited to the completed session (plus Codex lineage) with per-file/total/count caps; credentials no longer downloaded. Tests: remote-agent.test.ts, codex-lineage.test.ts.
REGRESSION? Full scans over 500 pages now throw (e2b.ts:888) and retry every sweep (runners.ts:326), so huge feeds never record usage. Tests: e2b-world.test.ts, runner-pools.test.ts.
Publish-slot query backs off 100 ms→5 s; account park uses condition(timeout) after patched CAN migration, no leaked race timers. Tests: resources.test.ts, coordinator-history.test.ts.
Writers emit Claude image blocks and Codex input_image parts; readable output labels embedded data; vendored byte-identical. Test: panagent tests/test_conversion.py.
Codex/Claude readers pair missing result ids FIFO with pending calls, consume matches, warn on orphans. Test: panagent tests/test_conversion.py.
Rendered output escapes lone surrogates (backslashreplace) for every writer. Test: panagent tests/test_conversion.py.
CLI boundary also catches UnicodeError/ValueError/TypeError/KeyError; readers type-guard records. Test: panagent tests/test_cli.py.
REGRESSION? readers.py:84 treats Claude title records (type summary, leafUuid, no uuid) as compaction: clears earlier messages, injects fake summary. Test: test_conversion.py.
Imports now pass --report and record session.import.warnings (conversation-imports.test.ts). Conversation-download export (panagent.ts:84) reads the report but discards its warnings.
Same-provider Claude uploads copy native records with fresh session/UUIDs instead of IR round-trip; truncated tail tolerated. Test: conversation-imports.test.ts.
panagent validates HTTPS share URL and each redirect; karmax fetches via DNS-pinned no-redirect HTTPS and converts local HTML. Tests: test_browser.py, panagent-share.test.ts.
Fallback limited to challenge/403/429; JSON exports no longer misdetected (test_browser.py). Whole-page marker scans remain: web.py:335, browser.py:211 (still matches 'verify you are human').
Opening/closing imported_conversation delimiters in source text escaped in both panagent handoff and karmax wrapper. Tests: test_conversion.py, conversation-imports.test.ts.

Truncated final JSONL record skipped with warning (panagent and karmax native path); cwd/workspace_roots and absolute source paths dropped; fail-on-warning ignores info. Tests: test_cli.py, test_conversion.py.
Version duplication removed: pyproject version dynamic from panagent.__version__, User-Agent derived from it. Test: panagent tests/test_cli.py.
docs/browser-export.md existed upstream since panagent@2ff34bb (pre-review). Not shipped in wheel or karmax vendor tree, though vendored web.py:338 cites it.

REGRESSION? writers.py:301 session_meta now lacks cli_version; pinned Codex 0.156.1 thread/read rejects such rollouts ("does not start with session metadata"), breaking generated Codex imports/exports.
panagent subprocess env limited to PYTHONPATH plus PATH/HOME/TMPDIR/locale/TLS/proxy variables. Test: conversation-imports.test.ts.
